usedFor: Copper holds your leads and projects, and paycove drafts the paperwork through “Create Invoice / Quote”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Copper, then “Create Invoice / Quote” in paycove
bestTemplate.why: A new project in Copper starts an invoice or quote in paycove, along with the contact.

watchOut: “Create Invoice / Quote” also creates the contact, so check paycove for an existing one before you turn it on.
